claims.text: Gives conflicting accounts of ownership of the same result-table and export implementation.

citations.quote: I wrote the result-table component and export logic myself.
Another engineer wrote both the result-table component and the export logic; I did not modify those files.

R1.limitation: Personal ownership of that implementation needs clarification; neither account resolves the conflict alone.
R1.followUp: Which result-table or export behaviors did you personally change, and which were implemented by your teammate?

claims.text: Reports proposing caching as a possible cause without capturing a trace or comparing response order.

citations.quote: I told the backend engineer it might be cached data because I had seen caching cause something similar elsewhere.
I did not capture a network trace or compare response order.

R2.limitation: The reported cause and effect of the later change are not established by this investigation account.
R2.followUp: What evidence would distinguish cached data from responses arriving out of order?

claims.text: Reports seeing rows and a downloaded file, and not adding a test for this change.

citations.quote: The table displayed rows and a file downloaded.
I did not add a test for this change.

R3.limitation: Relevant regression coverage and whether export contents matched the filters remain unestablished.
R3.followUp: Which assertion would verify that exported contents match the selected filters?

claims.text: Explicitly reports not doing a keyboard-only or screen-reader check on this screen.

citations.quote: I did not do a keyboard-only pass or use a screen reader on this screen.

R4.limitation: Completed accessibility verification is not established; a library assumption or future plan cannot establish it.
R4.followUp: What keyboard interaction and expected focus behavior would you check first?
